QuestInfo.name: Explorer Lv. 20 Challenge
QuestInfo.0: They say that you will receive an incredible gift if you reach Lv. 20 with an Explorer character.
QuestInfo.1: Reach Lv. 20 and receive a high quality weapon.
QuestInfo.2: You achieved Lv. 20 and received a high quality weapon.

0.0: It's time to aim for Lv. 20. There's plenty of time left, so you should be fine. I have some really great gifts prepared, so be sure to do your best!

yes.0: Be sure to see me once you've reached Lv. 20!

no.0: Well, if you knew what the gift was, I doubt you'd refuse. Let me know when you come to your senses.

1.1: Okay, here's the gift as I've promised! What do you think? Isn't it great? You can't equip it until you reach Lv. 30, but trust me, it'll be worth the wait! The gift is based on your job, so please accept it.

yes.0: I can't wait to see you equipped with the item once you reach Lv. 30!

default.0: It doesn't look like you've reached Lv. 20 yet. Please come back to me after reaching Lv. 20.

item.0: Hmm... It looks like you already have one of the Explorer Rings. Unfortunately, you won't be able to participate in this event.
